text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to interpret and understand visual information from the world. Instead of just capturing images, computers can now perform image recognition, identifying what is in a photo, such as a cat, a tree, or a human face. A more complex task is object detection, which not only names objects but also locates them with boxes. This technology has many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision systems constantly scan the road to detect pedestrians, other vehicles, and traffic signs, helping the car make safe decisions. From sorting photos on your phone to medical diagnosis, computer vision is changing how machines help us in daily life.
